rule: Every symbol on the reels is real Bitcoin or Stacks material. Nothing is drawn or imitated by hand. A Bitcoin Monkey with no Forever Twins twin is shown desaturated with a NOT YET FOREVER stamp.

collection.name: Bitcoin Monkeys
collection.note: 2,500 monkeys. Ids with no metadata from the metadata API are not in any tier (shown as stone-frame records when they appear).

tiers.method: Rarity score = sum over a monkey's (trait type, value) of ln(N / frequency), N = monkeys with metadata. The rarest 5% wear the gold frame (jackpot symbol, engine slot bitcoin); the rest wear the stone frame (engine slot artifact).
tiers.metadataSource: https://xtrata.xyz/hiro/mainnet/metadata/v1/nft/<contract>/<id> (a pass-through of the Hiro metadata API), read 2026-11-02
tiers.imageSource: IPFS QmYCnfeseno5cLpC75rmy6LQhsNYQCJabiuwqNUXMaA3Fo/<id>.png (one folder holds every monkey), through the Gamma resizing CDN https://images.gamma.io/cdn-cgi/image/width=160,height=160,format=webp/https://stxnft.mypinata.cloud/ipfs/<cid>/<id>.png, with public IPFS gateways as fallbacks

twins.note: At build time six monkeys had a Forever Twin: #2 (xtrata 3113), #378 (3118), #1012 (3114), #1282 (3115), #1295 (3116), #1296 (3117). Their pictures are saved from https://xtrata.xyz/i/<id> and bundled.

live.failedRead: A failed or empty read is shown as unknown, never as no twins.
